source: SEC EDGAR Form NPORT-P filings, Invesco S&P 500 Momentum ETF (SPMO), CIK 1378872, series S000050154
note: Public NPORT-P filings only cover the 3rd month of each fiscal quarter (Feb/May/Aug/Nov reporting dates), with a ~60-day filing lag; this fund's public snapshots landed on May/Nov reporting dates only. cusip/isin come directly from the filing; ticker is resolved via a static name+cusip lookup table maintained in this repo's build script. Dual share classes (e.g. GOOG/GOOGL) are NOT combined here -- each row is exactly as filed. Tickers are normalized to their CURRENT symbol for companies that renamed/re-ticked since the holding was filed: AmerisourceBergen->COR (Cencora), Fortune Brands Home & Security->FBIN, Fox Corp Class B->FOX, NortonLifeLock->GEN (Gen Digital), Healthpeak->DOC, PerkinElmer->RVTY (Revvity). Some historical constituents are now delisted/acquired and have no further price history available (e.g. ABMD, ANSS, ATVI, CERN, CTLT, CTRA*, CTXS, DFS, DRE, EA*, EQR*, FLT, FRC, HES, HOLX*, IPG, JNPR, K*, KSU, MMC*, MRO, PXD, SEE*, SIVB, TWTR, XLNX -- items marked * are still actively traded companies where the historicals lookup returned no data for this account/session, likely a transient gap rather than a real delisting).
